description: PAPER PREVIEW (sealed:false, is_keep:false, paper:true). Not a verdict; for a verdict use get_lab_desktop_handoff. Exports an ArenaScript strategy to Pine Script v5 ready to paste into TradingView (Lab engine semantics, fees 0.1%/side, no slippage). Returns the Pine code, the conversion status EXACT or PARTIAL with the lines not converted, and setup/chart review URLs. Never emits a TradingView aff_id: partner attribution is desktop proof-linked only. job_id (optional): the header cites the CUDA job re-read on the server only if the job's script is identical to the exported script (verification_status); it is an optimisation result, not a validation.
name: export_to_tradingview
